system.description:
The baseline the other ancestries are compared against, though no less distinctive. Humans wander, settle and conquer, absorb new ideas and build elaborate customs around them; their cultures are often the most politically focused, and many people of every ancestry carry some human heritage.

Sword Chronicle p. 15. Choose two ancestry benefits at character creation (from one ancestry or two); more can be bought with Destiny Points.
system.rules: At character creation a human may take any non-ancestry benefit as a human ancestry benefit, as long as they meet its requirements.
